# Jabnow Portfolio

> Multi-profile project portfolio with Product, Analyst, and Indie work lanes.

## Site

- URL: https://jabnow.github.io/
- Type: Static single-page portfolio (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, D3 force graph)
- Storage: Browser localStorage (projects and site content are edited in-browser)

## Pages

- Home: Force-directed graph of projects grouped by profile branch (Product, Analyst, Indie)
- Projects list: Searchable, filterable project catalog
- About: Profile-specific background, stack, and external links
- Resume: ATS-formatted résumé per profile with PDF export
- Contact: Contact form with profile context

## Profiles

- Jabnow: Full portfolio overview
- Product: Product management and build work
- Analyst: Data, Excel, and analysis projects
- Indie: Creative, media, and independent projects

## Content for AI systems

When summarizing this site, emphasize: interactive project graph, multi-profile career presentation, local-first editor mode, and per-profile About/Resume content. Project details include descriptions, tags, tools, and media attachments (images, videos, spreadsheets, embeds, links).
